#!/bin/bash
# M8 S7 E05 attempt 2 (owner rulings O2 + B1/B2 P2): seed 1337 run A, one OS process -- execution authority 7ff4d36f74cd64d6c405944d3b9fa4aee1fae521
date -u +%FT%TZ > /home/student20261/workdir/m8s7_E05_a2_s1337_A.launch_time
cd /home/student20261/workdir/m8_learned_banks/clones/s7e05a2_7ff4d36f74cd64d6c405944d3b9fa4aee1fae521 || { echo 97 > /home/student20261/workdir/m8s7_E05_a2_s1337_A.exit; exit 97; }
env -i HOME=/home/student20261 PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 nice -n 10 /home/student20261/miniconda3/envs/gpat-m6-e05/bin/python -B tools/learned_bank.py s7 --method E05 --label A --out-root /home/student20261/workdir/m8_learned_banks/s7/7ff4d36f74cd64d6c405944d3b9fa4aee1fae521/E05/seed_1337 --runtime-root /home/student20261/workdir/GPAT_TransferBench_runtime --seed 1337
echo $? > /home/student20261/workdir/m8s7_E05_a2_s1337_A.exit
date -u +%FT%TZ > /home/student20261/workdir/m8s7_E05_a2_s1337_A.end_time
